confidence.description: high = named vendor or spelled-out capability; medium = keyword only

context.description: how the topic surfaced; a quoted excerpt is present only for agenda-action

sourceType.description: how the meeting text was obtained

excerpt.description: quoted context; present only when context is agenda-action (any source)

followThrough.description: recorded = outcomes lists recorded items naming this topic; not-in-minutes = minutes read, no recorded item names it; no-results = minutes read, no readable recorded actions; null = no recorded-votes record for this meeting (says nothing about what happened)

outcomes.description: the same meeting's recorded agenda items whose caption carries this topic, joined on the portal's own meeting id

reference.description: the body's file number, where it has one

outline.description: agenda outline number, where items are numbered rather than filed

name.description: the agenda caption, truncated to about 300 characters

motion.description: the motion as recorded, where the portal names it

result.description: passed/failed only for adopted or failed wording; null for a step

resultClass.description: normalized result wording (adopted, adopted-substitute, held, referred, recommended, adversed, ...); null when the wording is not one we recognise

tally.description: [yes, no] as printed by the minutes, when printed

next.description: where the item goes next (committee and date), when recorded

textDisagrees.description: the minutes' own narrative contradicts this recorded tally; read the minutes

minutesUrl.description: the minutes the outcomes were read from

minutesDraft.description: true when those minutes are marked draft (re-read until final)
